# nihilurk

> nihilurk is a free, open-source Rogue-like (roguelike) for the terminal, written in Rust. Descend thirteen floors, take the Element of Yoord off the Dungeon Lord, and carry it back up. Turn-based grid, gear of unknown quality, traps, and permanent death. One binary, no assets.

Facts:

- Install: `cargo install nihilurk` (needs Rust 1.91 or newer), then run `nihilurk`.
- Two ways down: nihil (carries gear, the default) or the lurk (`-b lurk`, claws and fur). Seeded floors with `-s 1234`.
- Platforms: prebuilt binaries for Linux (x86_64, aarch64; static), Windows (x86_64) and macOS (Apple Silicon), on the releases page. Windows works (a tester built it with cargo and played it). macOS builds and passes its tests in CI, but nobody has played it there yet.
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Play

- [Instruction manual](@SITE_URL@MANUAL.html): controls, combat math, items, monsters, spells.

## Make things for it

- [Documentation index](@SITE_URL@docs/): tutorials, how-to guides, reference and explanation for adding monsters, items, traps and spells.
